只用标准 `mask-image` + 内联 SVG，无平台 API |
| Ubuntu / Debian 等 Linux（Chrome / Edge / Chromium） | ✅ CI 验证安

装链路 | 安装脚本、打包、安装冒烟测试跑在 `ubuntu-latest` 上 |
| Linux 上的 Firefox | ⚠️ 未实测 | 用到 `mask-image`（Firefox 支持无

- **时区**：时间胶囊用浏览器时区。Linux 服务器多为 UTC，此时显示的是 UTC；在 Console 执行
`window.__dshAccordion = { timeZone: 'As

ia/Shanghai' }` 后刷新页面即可覆盖。
- **动态效果**：尊重系统"减少动态效果"（`prefers-reduced-motion`），开启后不播放展开淡入。
- **字体**：时间
胶囊与摘要列按像素定宽，Ubuntu / SF 字体下宽度略有差异，不影响布局。
### 已知限制

- 依赖 DSH 聊天面板的内部 DOM 属性（`data-chat-turn` 等），属**非公开契约**，上游改版可能失效；失效时插件静默不动作，不会破坏界面。
- 折叠行是自绘的一行，行内链接需

先展开再点。
- 时间取自提问节点的事件时间；极少数节点没有 `time` 时不显示时间，只显示摘要。
- 未发布到 npm，按上面的本地 link 方式安装。
### What it is
A client plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). It never edits `app.asar` or any core UI source; it only
layers three behaviours on top of the rendered transcript:
1. Every finished interaction collapses into **one fixed line**: a time pill (`MM-DD HH:mm`) plus a

single-line summary of your question, ellipsized when long.
2. Only the **latest interaction** stays
open; opening any session, switching workspace/session, or starting a new turn resets the open stat

e to the newest turn (manual expansions are folded too).
3. Clicking a collapsed row expands that tu
rn and folds any other open turn; clicking the question again folds it back.
The execution process (thinking, tool calls, steps) does not expand with the turn: DSH folds it when
the answer completes, and it opens only when you click its own summary row.

### How it works
| Point | Detail |
| Mount | A client plugin (`dsh.client`, `platform: web`, `immediately: true`) loaded once with the

web app, so it covers every workspace and session |
| Turn grouping | Inside `[data-slot="conversati
on.chat.flow"]`, each rendered node carries `[data-chat-turn="<turnId>"]`; nodes sharing a turn id f

orm one turn |
| User node | The node whose subtree contains an element with a class ending in `_bub

ble` (user and steering bubbles share it) |
| Process node | The node with `data-chat-flow-kind="tur

n-process"`; its `button[aria-expanded]` is the built-in fold control |
| Folding | Marks every non-
user node of the turn with `data-ac-hidden` (`display:none`); the user row draws its pill and summar

y with pseudo-elements while the real bubble is `visibility:hidden` |
| State | An in-memory `Map` k
eyed by `turnId`; unknown turns default to "last one expanded", which is why session switches and hi

story reloads converge on their own |
| Timestamp | Read from the React fiber (`props.node.data.time

`) first, then the native clock text; nothing is invented if neither exists |
| Self-healing | `Muta
tionObserver` plus a 1.5 s safety sweep re-applies state after React re-renders |
Design stance: **layer, never invade**. Core folding, streaming output and scroll anchoring stay unt
ouched; when the structure cannot be recognised the plugin does nothing and logs a single `warn`.
### Compatibility
| Platform / engine | Status | Notes |

| Windows (DSH desktop, Electron/Chromium) | ✅ primary target | Development baseline |
| macOS (desk
top app; Tauri/WebView needs a recent engine) | ✅ designed to work | Standard `mask-image` plus inli

ne SVG only, no platform APIs |
| Ubuntu / Debian and other Linux (Chrome / Edge / Chromium) | ✅ ins

tall path verified in CI | installer, packaging and install smoke test run on `ubuntu-latest` |
| Fi
refox on Linux | ⚠️ not exercised | uses `mask-image` (Firefox ships the unprefixed property); worst
case the fade is lost, folding still works |
- **Time zone**: the time pill uses the browser time zone. A Linux server is often UTC, so rows show

UTC;
run `window.__dshAccordion = { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' }` in the console and reload to overr

ide.
- **Motion**: respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; the expand fade is skipped when it is enabled.
- **Fonts**: pill and summary columns are pixel-sized, so Ubuntu/SF fonts shift widths slightly wit
hout breaking the layout.
### Known limitations
- Relies on internal DOM attributes of the DSH chat panel (`data-chat-turn`, …). That is a **private

contract** and may break on an upstream redesign; the plugin then fails safe by doing nothing.
- Th

e folded row is self-drawn, so links inside a question need one click to expand first.
- Timestamps

come from the question node's event time; the rare node without `time` shows a summary only.
- Not p
ublished to npm; install it through the local link shown above.
